If it isn't there, look for a skill named `foreigners-pov` in your skills folders. If it isn't installed, say so in one line and give the install command: `npx skills add ForeignerfromJupiter/foreigners-pov`.

Read `../foreigners-pov/SKILL.md` and follow it for this whole task, including the question budget and the brain rules.

Then run `../foreigners-pov/modules/preflight.md`.

Items: what the user wrote with this command

If no item is given, pre-flight every item in `.foreigners-pov/backlog.md` whose status isn't ready. With three or more items, start one subagent per item in the same turn so they run in parallel, if your agent has subagents; otherwise go one item at a time, then merge the results into one table and update `backlog.md`.
